findings.finding: We could not establish the full dissertation findings of Quintavalle (2022) is the opening verdict; the following clause identifies decoding guarantees, logical gate constructions and confinement-based single-shot correction. Counts 0/4, 0/2, 0/2 and 0/3 preserve production scope.

Opening independently states full findings not established; finite checks support parts while universal theorems and production estimates remain unresolved. All four missing-estimate denominators and four published sustainable thresholds appear immediately.
Definitions and distinction between our finite implementation and source theoretical/numerical work are self-contained; no earlier draft or review needed.

Historical revisions are explicitly run provenance, not claims of publishing this repair. Rebuild and scientific rerun instructions are separated. All 20 pages read and visually inspected; phrase scanner yielded no cues.

All headline claims present with substantive Published and Ours cells, independent effect/direction columns and finite or unassessed verdicts. Random-family row now preserves unclear scaling and expected adverse large-distance trend.
Linear-confinement theorem with growing-distance and degree conditions is distinct from general-confinement conjecture; source capacity, suppression and three random products retained.

All 41 packet claim IDs mapped to A.1-A.41 across pages 6-17; source statements, ours outcomes, status and required scope compared against packet. Chapter inventory entries are documentary, not chapter-wide successes.
Random-code component scope and open problems retained.
All nine appendix rows retained; quantum distance explicitly inherited rather than exhaustively proved.

All six packet limitations retained: inspected pages with remaining phase and grid limits, finite scope, missing designs, zero production estimates, measured stopping cost and provisional gate/partition discrepancies.
Competing error/convention explanations are not resolved as author error. Recovering original artifacts and proof audit remain required.

361 schedule and 256 ideal CZ checks do not validate noisy steps; 31232 residual checks and 4096 error enumeration do not prove universal confinement or a stochastic threshold. 617/72 is a reconstructed diagnostic, not source fit.
Recipes distinguish report rebuild from calculations and original data acquisition; pilots are not fitted production results.

Quintavalle (2022) identifies the cited dissertation. Title-page extraction L0-L6 verifies author initials, 2022, title and Sheffield; availability ledger verifies expanded author name. Abstract composite finding corresponds to Chapters 3-5; no source universal proof claimed as ours.

Full dissertation identity and institutional record URL match supplied source evidence; the thesis PDF was read and the rendered headline pages were inspected, and the phase convention remains unresolved.

Capacity +6.05 pp =21.55-15.5, tolerance .055=.005+.05; suppression +.76=1.91-1.15, tolerance .01=.005+.005. Positive meaning and units explicit. Our fitted values absent, so magnitude/direction correctly not established. Standard errors are not rounding margins or equivalence evidence.
Sustainable topology contrasts .18 and .12 pp remain separate with .01 tolerance, and no pooled effect is assigned. Source numbers remain visible even where comparison is unresolved.

Twelve non-scalar rows retain propositions or multicomponent findings without fabricated zero effects or aggregate margins. Only capacity and suppression carry justified scalar contrasts. Source high-noise repair claim and reconstructed diagnostic are not a comparable scalar source/ours pair.
Four sustainable thresholds remain explicit; no averaging of surface/toric decoder differences. Unassessed means missing independent assessment, not equality.

The theorem concerns arbitrary adversarial errors using seed and transpose oracles; O(k) calls and O(n^2) work are not measured by finite phase-error tests. 14+862+1+19+66+99=1061. Published and Ours checked separately; full source passage/result field evidence in provenance/finding-row-review.json.

Observed endpoint increase is reconstructed, not digitized source values; four sizes and 56 settings with 10000 trials each. Sampling intervals do not cover reconstruction choices. Published and Ours checked separately; full source passage/result field evidence in provenance/finding-row-review.json.

Source Figure 4 caption calls both families anti-threshold, but L2644-2649 explicitly qualify random panel as less clear, with no common crossing and larger-distance adverse trend expected. Final Published cell now preserves this qualification. Our run absent because seeds/grid unrecovered. Published and Ours checked separately; full source passage/result field evidence in provenance/finding-row-review.json.

Source theorem specifies logical X/Z line support and unique anticommutation pairing. Finite assertions support only 256 2x2 pairs and six examples; no universal proof. Published and Ours checked separately; full source passage/result field evidence in provenance/finding-row-review.json.

Source requires intermediate ReShape correction and has high-weight intermediate-stabilizer/time limits. Saved booleans explicitly deny noisy fault-tolerance verification. Published and Ours checked separately; full source passage/result field evidence in provenance/finding-row-review.json.

LDPC family, good confinement and polynomial growing distance d>=a*n^b,a,b>0 are essential; X-only confinement gives Pauli-Z result. 31232 finite residual checks cannot establish family theorem. Published and Ours checked separately; full source passage/result field evidence in provenance/finding-row-review.json.

Bounded qubit degree, good linear confinement and polynomial growing distance required. General good-confinement stochastic extension at preceding lines is conjectural. No proof claimed in Ours. Published and Ours checked separately; full source passage/result field evidence in provenance/finding-row-review.json.

The extracted theorem says t=Z distance and cubic f(x)=x^3/4 or better. The rendered theorem page was inspected; finite example enumerates 2^12 errors, not all 3D products. Published and Ours checked separately; full source passage/result field evidence in provenance/finding-row-review.json.

All four values and source standard errors preserved: surface MWPM+BP/OSD 3.08(.04)%, twice 2.90(.01)%; toric 2.90(.02)% and 2.78(.02)%. Separate topology contrasts .18 and .12 pp; no pooled scalar. Published and Ours checked separately; full source passage/result field evidence in provenance/finding-row-review.json.

21.55(.01)% is toric BP+OSD phase-flip threshold; 15.5% is cited Sweep prior work, not a new sweep experiment. Difference +6.05 pp, rounding tolerance .005+.05=.055 pp; source uncertainty not equivalence. Published and Ours checked separately; full source passage/result field evidence in provenance/finding-row-review.json.

Both 10000-trial arms use toric L5,p=.1,q=.03,N1 and differ in repair setting. 617/72=8.5694, not over tenfold. Source over-tenfold report and ours diagnostic remain separate; exact source depth/grid absent, original final perfect round adds fresh data noise. Published and Ours checked separately; full source passage/result field evidence in provenance/finding-row-review.json.

N0 and N8 source beta estimates retain .03 standard errors; difference +.76 dimensionless, rounding bound .005+.005=.01. No fitted ours value or effect direction can be asserted. Published and Ours checked separately; full source passage/result field evidence in provenance/finding-row-review.json.

Source Table III parameters [[1336,4,6]], [[3100,5,8]], [[5964,6,10]] and Figure 4 approximate 2.7% crossing at N16 are numerical evidence, not proof of conjecture. Three components preserved in appendix. Published and Ours checked separately; full source passage/result field evidence in provenance/finding-row-review.json.

Chapter 6 explicitly lacks comprehensive encoded-operation framework. Chapter 5 conjecture generalizes beyond established linear-confinement theorem; no architecture demonstration or conjecture proof inferred. Published and Ours checked separately; full source passage/result field evidence in provenance/finding-row-review.json.

manual_items.finding: All 20 final pages visually inspected; first-page 14 rows readable and no overlap/clipping; raw appendix inequality glyphs repaired.
14 source/finding rows checked against original text and actual saved values; not based only on writer declarations.
Independent editorial aid only; neither a universal proof nor human scientific certification. The rendered headline pages were inspected after the earlier cold read.

remaining_scientific_blockers: The thesis PDF was read and the rendered pages supporting headline and Published entries were inspected. Missing simulation grids and the phase convention remain provisional.
Finite binary checks do not prove the dissertation universal theorems or noisy fault tolerance.
Original stochastic grids, tie conventions, random seeds, MWPM implementation and surface L11 code were not recovered.
0 of 4 sustainable thresholds, 0 of 2 capacity analyses, 0 of 2 suppression fits, and 0 of 3 random-code performance analyses were completed.
Toric L11 pilot completed 9 trials in 180 seconds: approximately 55.6 CPU-hours per 10000-trial point; full production grids are unresolved.
Sibling gate and partition discrepancies are candidate source-comparison gaps. The printed figures were inspected; the phase convention is not settled. They are not established source errors.

items.layout: Visually inspected all 20 final PDF pages at 1.4-scale renders. Page 1 contains all 14 readable rows with separate Published/Ours, magnitude, direction and verdict columns, without overlap or clipping. Body and appendices remain legible, including corrected inequality glyphs on pages 12-13. First-page .55-inch margins and 9.5-point table text versus .82-inch, 11-point body are explicitly disclosed on page 19; verified in current manuscript preamble.
items.headline_and_tolerance: Page 1 and page 2 open with the unresolved composite verdict and preserve all 4/2/2/3 missing production denominators. All 14 Published/Ours cells were independently checked against original extracted passages and saved results. Four sustainable thresholds and source errors remain explicit. Capacity +6.05 pp has rounding tolerance .055; suppression +.76 has tolerance .01. No ours fits or scalar aggregate are invented; source standard errors remain distinct from tolerance and point-estimate comparisons are explicitly not equivalence.
items.citations: Read current references.tex and matched all five manuscript citation keys to bibliography entries; no undefined keys. Final pages 19-20 identify Quintavalle dissertation, Wilson, NIST and software references. Dissertation identity checked against title-page extraction and availability ledger; Wilson/NIST metadata against sources/method-citations.json. Actual external reference URIs agree with visible identities. This review does not newly verify Wilson full-text content, source PDF ink, every software version installation or remote URL availability; those verification limits are disclosed.
items.ledgers: Read and compared all 41 Appendix A entries across final pages 6-17 with packet claim statements, outcomes, statuses and required scopes, and the six limitations on pages 5-6 with packet limits. Read regeneration ledger on page 18 and compliance ledger on page 19: calculations versus report rebuild, historical provenance, intentional layout/engine departures and inspected source pages and the remaining phase limit are distinguished. Inventories are not treated as independent proof. The separate 14-row attribution ledger retains source passages and actual result fields.
items.links: Canonical extraction from final PDF yields 163 actual URI annotations and 43 distinct destinations. Reviewed complete destination/label grouping against final rendered pages, including wrapped filename fragments. Study artifact links use alectionary/vibe-math master paths. Verified decoder, interval, tensor, phase, main-run and upstream-run line anchors plus README reproduce heading against local text. External citation/software targets match labels. Semantic/navigation review does not assert HTTP availability or publication of these exact final bytes.
items.independence_limits: A fresh-context cold read of only specified PDF and three handoff criteria was recorded before packet, writer manifest or evidence was opened. Then original extraction passages and saved results were checked, followed by all-page final visual reinspection. No prior reviews/manuscripts or research conversation read, no scientific reruns, and no paper/result edits by reviewer. Phase conventions, universal proofs, noisy fault tolerance and production fits remain unresolved. Hash fields for this PDF were rebound after rendered-page inspection in the same working context; that rebinding is not a new independent cold read. This editorial review is not human scientific certification.
